keyboard.behavior: Focus the authored links and optional close button.
Activate a focused native dismiss button. No built-in focus restoration is supplied after the alert is removed.

guidelines: Reserve role="alert" for urgent messages; routine updates should not interrupt the user.
Keep recovery instructions available, and do not automatically dismiss validation errors.
The alert starts visible in normal markup. The plugin adds hiding during exit, removes the element, emits closed and disposes its instance.
Application code can cancel close or handle closed.trm.alert to move focus to a suitable surviving element. Focus restoration is not automatic.
Use an empty, named native btn-close with data-trm-dismiss="alert"; use actual theme classes, not retired alert-color aliases.

name: button
title: Button
lead: Trigger actions with solid, outline, subtle, text, size, and toggle variants.

variants.title: Theme-driven styles
variants.description: Choose a structural variant and a semantic theme; there are no btn-primary-style aliases. The neutral base btn is also available.

variants.title: Sizes and icon buttons
variants.description: Use xs, sm, the default size or lg. Icon-only controls need an accessible name; variants already include base button styling.

variants.title: Toggle and disabled states
variants.description: The Button plugin toggles active and aria-pressed. Native disabled prevents user activation; a disabled navigation example has no href and is removed from the tab order.
variants.markup: Unavailable link

variants.title: Native checkbox buttons
variants.description: Put a real checkbox inside a btn-check label. Native checked/focus semantics and CSS :has() styling are separate from the Button plugin.

variants.title: Groups and toolbars
variants.description: Name related native controls. These CSS containers do not supply a roving-tabindex or editor implementation.

variants.title: Styled solid buttons
variants.description: The styled modifier adds the actual gradient/shadow treatment to a solid variant; it is not a replacement theme.

variants.title: Dark mode and RTL
variants.description: Existing theme tokens and logical layout adapt to dark RTL content. This example uses the inverse theme deliberately.

keyboard.behavior: Activate a focused native button; the Button data API synchronizes pressed state when enabled.
Follow an enabled navigation link. A button-styled link does not gain native Space activation.
Move through native enabled controls. Checkbox buttons retain native checkbox behavior.

guidelines: Use native buttons for actions and real links for navigation; declare non-submit button types explicitly.
Always name icon-only controls. Keep a toggle button label stable while aria-pressed communicates state.
A disabled class or aria-disabled alone is not an activation guard. Use native disabled, or remove/guard a disabled link destination deliberately.
Do not mix the Button plugin and native checkbox state on the same control.
Semantic color names are not a contrast guarantee. Copy the disclosed demo CSS with customized color examples, or choose and test accessible foreground/background pairs.
